description: Read the stored popularity (integer 1–100) and difficulty (0–100) of one exact keyword in one storefront. Each metric has its own evidence, source time, freshness and last-attempt status; a missing value stays null and is never zero. This read never starts a measurement — use hive_measure_keyword_metrics for that. iOS only.

country.description: storefront code, e.g. us (defaults to us)

name: hive_keyword_metrics
